description: Read the Rust package registry from a workflow. Search all 300,000+ crates by name, description, category or keyword, read a crate's metadata, licence, owners and README, and walk its full version history with each release's date, size, checksum and minimum Rust version. List what a version depends on and which crates depend on it, chart 90 days of downloads for a crate or a single version, and get the download URL and SHA-256 of any .crate file. Browse the registry's categories and keywords, look up users and teams, read the front-page summary, and check whether crates.io is accepting writes before a release goes out. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything on crates.io. No account or API token required.
